limitations: Retinal values are public-display quantized to uint8; neural readouts retain exact float32 bytes.
Entity geometry uses one full keyframe followed by full-object replacement deltas; exact host states remain content-addressed in the private raw recording.
Rendered entity and articulation geometry is rounded to five decimal places for the public replay.
Phenomena labels index observed physical changes and do not interpret intention or learning.
The recording samples one resident's direct retina and neural readouts while retaining all resident motion.

privacy.private_state: only goal recorded time and remaining commitment are exported; memory content, slots, account identity, and native controller state are excluded

coarse_projection.method: unweighted area pooling of measured rays
coarse_projection.purpose: declared 5x16x4 projection for the canonical 351 neural port encoder

sensorium.layout: resident-major, peripheral then foveal, elevation, azimuth, component

provenance.source_content_semantics: caller-pinned source archive or the identical engine_identity.sha256

recorded_body_state.timing: post-physics host view at frame model_time; not the normalized pre-action controller input

sampling.model_interval_semantics: minimum requested interval; observed ticks and times are authoritative
sampling.transport: read-only HTTP GET /api/state; no browser and no world commands

status: observed physical recording; behavior and growth are not evidence of learned competence
